From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick demo? Tailored walkthrough after usage threshold

Hi Alex,

Congrats on getting Acme Analytics up and running with Redwood — I noticed your org just crossed our 100k token usage threshold this month (nice work!). We typically offer a short, tailored walkthrough at this milestone to show best practices for latency/cost reductions, prompt engineering tips, and how teams use Redwood Optimize to get the most out of batching and caching.

Suggested agenda (30 minutes):
- Quick intro & objectives (5m)
- A short look at your usage patterns + quick wins (10m)
- Demo: model routing, batching & a sample prompt walkthrough (10m)
- Next steps / Q&A (5m)

If that sounds useful, you can pick a 30-minute slot that works here: https://calendly.com/redwood/camila-30m — or reply with a few times that work and I can send an invite.

Attaching a short deck that highlights the typical playbook we cover: RDW-demo-deck.pdf (attached).

Thanks and looking forward to connecting,

--
Camila Reyes | SDR, Redwood Inference
camila@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0142
